```yaml
name: Auto‑approve Copilot PRs

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  auto-approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Auto‑approve Copilot PR
        uses: github/auto-approve-action@v2
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
